rubrics.text: black blood when teeth are extracted
behind the base of the uvula
discharge of stinking brown ichor on making incision near second molar
spots in forepart as if ulcers would form
folded like little bags on edges
covered with tough mucus which lies in brown crusts on lips
resulting in unclean ulcer with hard edges
low down in region of hyoid bone
as by a string to the hyoid bone
darting in and out like a snake's
exerts himself a long time before he can utter a word
cannot speak a syllable though she makes the effort
in socket of a tooth that has been out for years
with stitches up to left temple
although it is salted as usual
low down in when hawking up mucus
things which formerly had strong taste
with drawing sensation as if a string were pulling center of tongue toward hyoid bone
extending from throat to roof of
after suppressed brown herpetic eruption on face
